summary: WebDAV lets clients manage files on web servers, and many such servers limit how much storage can be used. This document defines properties that let a client discover the quota available and the amount used for a collection of resources. It is a standards-track specification meant to help clients and servers interoperate.

eli5.summary: Imagine a locker with a limit on how much you can stuff inside. This lets your computer ask the locker how much room is left and how much you have already used.

questions: how does webdav report disk quota
